producer_report.summary: I added the design note `docs/design/direct-main-single-commit-landing.md`, a CHANGELOG entry, and a new appended decision, D178. The note covers the change, how it removes the wait, the existing code it builds on, alternatives, risks and the failure path. It also states the 5.0-minute estimate and how the next review measures it. It cites review 20261113-190159-mapn and says an implementing change must cite that id. `docs/design/direct-main-merge-tree-landing.md` already proposes the same mechanism for an earlier review. The new note builds on it and says so.
